title: No-Human in the Loop: Agentic Evaluation at Scale for Recommendation

bias_targets.methodology: Applying multi-agent scalable majority voting across 36 different LLMs to synthesize a consensus ground truth, thereby mitigating systematic biases from any single model (such as verbosity effects, position bias, and model-family preferences).

bias_targets.target: Age and Gender Bias (Demographic Targeting Mismatch)
bias_targets.methodology: Deploying a specialized LLM Recommendation Issue Audit Agent with predefined issue codes to evaluate and flag candidate product recommendations that have a mismatch in intended demographic (e.g., inappropriately recommending toddler shoes for a men's dress shirt).
